reviewNotes: First-party MIT Unified External Tool & Manual Session Control Plane (cyberlab/external/control-plane.ts).

Governs external binaries (nmap, nuclei, ffuf, tshark, opentrap, mvt, ghidra) via shell=false, ScopeController, AbortSignal kill-switch, supervised CLI wrapping, and .cyberlab/inbox SHA-256 ingestion without embedding third-party copyleft/proprietary code.
